scope: Static review and offline synthetic preprocessing/generation/encoding-interface checks; not scientific result reproduction.

checks.name: all_python_syntax
checks.detail: All included Python files compile without executing their entry points.

checks.name: seven_originals_provenance
checks.detail: All seven original mappings/hashes match; build-time whole-AST comparison permits only documented path/import/mkdir edits and one unit-comment correction.

checks.name: network_contract_static
checks.detail: Training and both inference SprintMLP definitions are AST-identical; h1/h2/h3/dropout match. Real checkpoint loading was not tested.

checks.name: molar_branch_and_unit_diagnostic
checks.detail: All-molar synthetic inputs normalise correctly. Confirmed diagnostic: 1m is treated as M by the supplied parser.

checks.name: mixed_unit_diagnostic
checks.detail: Confirmed source-code edge case on synthetic input: bare-number solvent ratios plus M salt return solvent-only fractions. This is a detected limitation, not evidence the real dataset used this branch.

checks.name: unify_excel_io_and_bridge_gap
checks.detail: Unify writes its result with portable paths/new output directory; confirmed that required downstream six-slot columns are not created.

checks.name: six_slot_to_sequence_integration
checks.detail: Two actual entry points passed temporary Excel-to-CSV integration on a separately prepared synthetic six-slot input; sequence order, empty slots, mol% multiplication, numeric conditions and target pass-through verified.

checks.name: candidate_small_io_smoke
checks.detail: Generated 25 temporary synthetic candidates (test-only row limit and fictional component properties; progress display stubbed). Mass fractions, normalisation, six-slot format and output-directory creation verified. No paper candidate counts reproduced.

checks.name: auxiliary_salt_unit_diagnostic
checks.detail: Observed 582 auxiliary-salt cases in a small synthetic sampling check; their mass fraction is 0.01, i.e. 1 wt%. Numeric sampling logic remains unchanged.

checks.name: inference_input_helpers
checks.detail: Sequence-column priorities and per-row numeric condition fallback checked; actual embeddings and neural inference were not executed.

checks.name: source_upload_safety
checks.detail: No model weights, curated dataset, source PDFs or real API-key files included. The original uploads were not modified.

checks.name: nine_script_syntax_and_provenance
checks.detail: All nine adapted author scripts compile; source-map hashes match. New-script AST equivalence allows only documented path setup and wording changes.

checks.name: encoding_array_interface_with_explicit_test_doubles
checks.detail: 67 synthetic rows exercised batches 32/32/3, preserved row order, saved float32 [N,770]/[N], used embedding/T/rate order and applied missing-temperature=25 / missing-rate=1. Fake encoder/tensor only: no real SMI-TED or PyTorch execution.

checks.name: array_diagnostic_entry_point
checks.detail: Diagnostic script ran on synthetic NPY files without modifying them; its alignment wording is limited to row count and its target check warns on 72.1. It does not prove per-row pairing or prior standardisation.

checks.name: supplied_loader_static_and_regex_review
checks.detail: Loader copied byte-for-byte; syntax, expected function signatures, eval, detach and absence of RDKit normalisation in encode_raw checked statically. Isolated supplied regex yields s/p/> for <sep>. No real checkpoint/tokenizer/neural execution.

not_executed: Reproduction of dataset counts, paper metrics, candidate counts or figures
encoding_test_doubles: The added encoding smoke test substitutes torch.cat/tensors and load_smi_ted/encode_raw solely to check array orchestration. Actual encoder behaviour remains unverified.
